name: WP Screenshot
author: Lars Bachmann

sections.description:
Insert screenshots in your post and pages using a simple shortcode.

[screenshot width=”700″ alt=”WordPress”]wordpress.org[/screenshot]

Will show a screenshot of wordpress.org (700px width).
Insert URLs without https://

This plugin uses mshots from WordPress.

It’s a very handy plugin, and you can use it on your portfolio page, webdirectory etc.

See screenshot examples at https://larsbachmann.dk/plugins/wp-screenshot
sections.installation:
1. Upload the /wp-screenshot folder to /plugins
  2. Activate plugin
  3. Insert shortcode to show a screenshot of a webpage
  4. ex: [screenshot width=”550″ alt=”Lars Bachmann”]larsbachmann.dk[/screenshot]
